sos.wyo.gov.es: la Secretaría de Estado de Wyoming

reg_deadline.en: Regular registration closed October 19, but you can still register and vote at the same time: in person with your county clerk through Monday, November 2, or at your polling place on Election Day. Bring proof of identity, U.S. citizenship and Wyoming residency.
reg_deadline.es: El registro regular cerró el 19 de octubre, pero todavía puedes registrarte y votar al mismo tiempo: en persona con el secretario de tu condado (county clerk) hasta el lunes 2 de noviembre, o en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones. Lleva comprobantes de identidad, ciudadanía estadounidense y residencia en Wyoming.
reg_deadline.quote: Voter Registration Closes: General ………… October 19, 2026 Election Day: General ………… Voters may register and vote at their polling places Voters may still register in person and cast an absentee ballot October 20 – November 2, 2026
reg_deadline.en_after: Regular registration closed October 19, but you can still register and vote at the same time at your polling place on Election Day. Bring proof of identity, U.S. citizenship and Wyoming residency.
reg_deadline.es_after: El registro regular cerró el 19 de octubre, pero todavía puedes registrarte y votar al mismo tiempo en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones. Lleva comprobantes de identidad, ciudadanía estadounidense y residencia en Wyoming.

mail_request.en: Ask your county clerk by phone, mail, email, in person or with the state's online request form, any day through Monday, November 2. You don't need a reason. Requests aren't taken on Election Day.
mail_request.es: Pídela al secretario de tu condado (county clerk) por teléfono, correo postal, correo electrónico, en persona o con el formulario en línea del estado, cualquier día hasta el lunes 2 de noviembre. No necesitas dar una razón. No se aceptan solicitudes el Día de las Elecciones.
mail_request.quote: Any registered voter in Wyoming may request an absentee ballot for any or all elections ONLY within the calendar year in which the election is held but not on the day of the election. ... By Phone – Call your county clerk By Mail – Print and fill out the application form and mail to your county clerk By Email – Put “Absentee Ballot Request” in the subject line In Person – Request an absentee ballot in person at your county clerk’s office Online Request Forms – Select the applicable form below
mail_request.en_after: Requests closed November 2. You can still vote at your polling place, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes cerraron el 2 de noviembre. Todavía puedes votar en tu lugar de votación, de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m.

mail_return.en: Your county clerk's office must receive it by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Bring it in the signed envelope to the clerk's office, or mail it. Mail inside the county can take up to seven days, longer from outside it.
mail_return.es: La oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk) debe recibirla a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. Llévala en el sobre firmado a la oficina del secretario, o mándala por correo. El correo dentro del condado puede tardar hasta siete días, y más desde fuera del condado.
mail_return.quote: All Absentee ballots must be received in the county clerk's office no later than 7:00 p.m. on Election Day. Ballots arriving after the deadline will not be counted. ... In Person – Bring your completed absentee ballot in the signed envelope to your county clerk’s office. By Mail – Mail your completed absentee ballot in the provided envelope to your county clerk’s office. (Mail delivery within the county may take up to seven (7) days, and longer if you’re mailing your ballot from outside the county.)

early_hours.en: In-person absentee voting runs Tuesday, October 6 to Monday, November 2, 2026. Ask your county clerk where and when.
early_hours.es: La votación en ausencia en persona va del martes 6 de octubre al lunes 2 de noviembre de 2026. Pregunta al secretario de tu condado dónde y a qué hora.
early_hours.en_after: Absentee voting ended November 2. Vote at your polling place on Election Day, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
early_hours.es_after: La votación en ausencia terminó el 2 de noviembre. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones, de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m.

cure.notes: No absentee ballot cure process found on sos.wyo.gov.

in_person.en: Vote absentee in person with your county clerk through Monday, November 2, or at your polling place on Election Day, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. In counties with vote centers, you can vote at any polling place in the county. Your county clerk can tell you if yours has them.
in_person.es: Vota en ausencia en persona con el secretario de tu condado (county clerk) hasta el lunes 2 de noviembre, o en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones, de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m. En los condados con centros de votación, puedes votar en cualquier lugar de votación del condado. El secretario de tu condado te dice si el tuyo los tiene.
in_person.quote: Vote centers allow for residents in a county to vote at ANY polling place location in that county. ... Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., or until the last person in line at 7 p.m. has voted.

first_time.en: Registered by mail and voting absentee in your first federal election? Put a copy of your photo ID, or a document with your name and home address, in the envelope with your ballot.
first_time.es: ¿Te registraste por correo y vas a votar en ausencia en tu primera elección federal? Mete en el sobre, junto con tu boleta, una copia de tu identificación con foto o de un documento con tu nombre y domicilio.
first_time.quote: If you registered to vote by mail and are voting by absentee ballot in your first federal election, you must enclose a copy of your photo ID or document bearing your name and residence address in the envelope with your voted ballot.

locator_label.en: Polling Place Locator (Wyoming Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Búsqueda de lugares de votación (Secretaría de Estado de Wyoming)

rule.en: Enter your address in the state's Polling Place Locator, or call your county clerk's office. Polls are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
rule.es: Escribe tu dirección en el buscador de lugares de votación del estado, o llama a la oficina del secretario de tu condado. Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m.
rule.quote: Enter your address in our Polling Place Locator, found on our website or contact your county clerk’s office.

en: Wyoming driver's license or ID card
Driver's license or ID card from another state
Valid Medicare or Medicaid insurance card (accepted through December 31, 2029)
es: Licencia de conducir o tarjeta de identificación de Wyoming
Licencia de conducir o tarjeta de identificación de otro estado
Identificación de estudiante de la Universidad de Wyoming (University of Wyoming)
Identificación de estudiante de un colegio comunitario de Wyoming
Identificación de estudiante de una escuela pública de Wyoming
Tarjeta vigente del seguro de Medicare o Medicaid (se acepta hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2029)
Permiso vigente de Wyoming para portar armas ocultas (concealed firearm permit)
accepted.quote: Any of the following documents will be accepted: WY Driver's License or ID Card Tribal ID Card Valid US Passport US Military Card DL or ID Card from Another State University of Wyoming Student ID Wyoming Community College Student ID Wyoming Public School Student ID Valid Medicare Insurance Card* Valid Medicaid Insurance Card* Valid Wyoming Concealed Firearm Permit

expired.notes: The SOS list says 'Valid' for the passport, Medicare and Medicaid cards and firearm permit only; no general expired-ID rule found.

without.en: No acceptable ID with you? You can still vote a provisional ballot after signing an oath. For it to count, bring proof that you're eligible to your county clerk by close of business on Wednesday, November 4. If you don't have any ID on the list, you can get a free Wyoming ID card at your local Driver Services office.
without.es: ¿No traes una identificación aceptada? Aun así puedes votar con una boleta provisional después de firmar un juramento. Para que cuente, lleva un comprobante de que puedes votar al secretario de tu condado (county clerk) antes del cierre de oficina del miércoles 4 de noviembre. Si no tienes ninguna identificación de la lista, puedes sacar gratis una tarjeta de identificación de Wyoming en la oficina local de servicios para conductores (Driver Services).
without.quote: If a person is unable to present acceptable identification immediately before voting at the polling place or absentee polling place, the person may vote by provisional ballot pursuant to W.S. 22-15-105.
without.notes: W.S. 22-2-119 (quote). 22-15-105(b) oath; 22-15-105(d): documentation to the county clerk 'until the close of business on the day following the election'. The free-ID line is from sos.wyo.gov/Elections/VoterID/Default.aspx: 'If you do not have one of the documents in the list above, you may obtain a free Wyoming Identification Card from your local Driver Services office.' Before Oct 30 this field said only the free-ID line, which read as no way to vote without ID. Read Oct 30, 2026 (wyoleg PDF by curl).

who.en: Any registered Wyoming voter can vote absentee, and you don't need to give a reason. Most people who mail their ballot don't need to send ID. The exception: if you registered by mail and this is your first federal election, include a copy of your ID.
who.es: Cualquier votante registrado en Wyoming puede votar en ausencia, y no necesitas dar una razón. La mayoría de quienes mandan su boleta por correo no tienen que mandar identificación. La excepción: si te registraste por correo y es tu primera elección federal, incluye una copia de tu identificación.
who.quote: You do not have to give a reason for requesting an absentee ballot. ... If you registered to vote by mail and are voting by absentee ballot in your first federal election, you must enclose a copy of your photo ID or document bearing your name and residence address in the envelope with your voted ballot.

dropbox.notes: The SOS absentee page lists only in-person return to the county clerk's office and mail; no drop boxes.

gear.en: On Election Day, no campaigning of any kind, including signs and handing out literature, within 100 yards of any public entrance to the building where you vote. At absentee polling places on other days, the limit is 100 feet. One small bumper sticker per candidate on your parked car is allowed while you vote.
gear.es: El Día de las Elecciones, no se permite ningún tipo de campaña, incluidos letreros y repartir propaganda, a menos de 100 yardas de cualquier entrada pública del edificio donde votas. En los lugares de votación en ausencia, los otros días, el límite es de 100 pies. Una calcomanía pequeña por candidato en la defensa de tu auto estacionado sí se permite mientras votas.
gear.quote: within one hundred (100) yards on the day of a primary, general or special election and within one hundred (100) feet on all other days, of any public entrance to the building in which the polling place is located.

phone.notes: Checked 2026-10-28: no Wyoming statute on ballot photos or phones in Title 22 (wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title22.pdf) and nothing on sos.wyo.gov FAQ; no official sentence to quote.

line.en: Waiting to vote at 7 p.m.? Stay. You can still vote.
line.es: ¿Estás esperando para votar a las 7 p. m.? Quédate. Todavía puedes votar.
line.quote: Any eligible elector present and waiting to vote at the polls at 7:00 p.m. shall be allowed to vote.

tradition.en: In 2019, the Secretary of State's office ran an I Voted sticker contest for Wyoming high school juniors and seniors and college students, marking 150 years of women's suffrage in Wyoming. The rules said county clerks would hand out the stickers at polling places during early voting and on Election Day.
tradition.es: En 2019, la Secretaría de Estado hizo un concurso de stickers "I Voted" para estudiantes de penúltimo y último año de preparatoria y estudiantes universitarios de Wyoming, por los 150 años del voto femenino en Wyoming. Las reglas decían que los secretarios de condado (county clerks) repartirían los stickers en los lugares de votación durante la votación anticipada y el Día de las Elecciones.
tradition.quote: 150th Anniversary ... The contest is open to students enrolled in a Wyoming high school (Junior or Senior) or a Wyoming college. ... The Wyoming County Clerks will be distributing the stickers at polling places during Early Voting and on Election Day.

provisional.en: If you can't show an acceptable ID or your eligibility can't be confirmed, ask for a provisional ballot. For it to count, bring proof that you're eligible to your county clerk by close of business on Wednesday, November 4.
provisional.es: Si no puedes mostrar una identificación aceptada o no se puede confirmar que tienes derecho a votar, pide una boleta provisional. Para que cuente, lleva un comprobante de que puedes votar al secretario de tu condado (county clerk) antes del cierre de oficina del miércoles 4 de noviembre.
provisional.quote: In order for your vote to be counted, you must provide proof of your eligibility to vote to the county clerk no later than close of business the day following the election.

line.en: You can still vote. Polls stay open until the last person in line at 7 p.m. has voted.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Los lugares de votación siguen abiertos hasta que vote la última persona que estaba en la fila a las 7 p. m.
line.quote: Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., or until the last person in line at 7 p.m. has voted.

track.en: Call your county clerk to check on your absentee ballot.
track.es: Llama a la oficina del secretario de tu condado para saber cómo va tu boleta de voto en ausencia.
track.quote: Contact your county clerk for information on the status of your ballot.

late_mail.en: It counts only if your county clerk receives it by 7 p.m. on Election Day, whatever the postmark. If time is short, bring it to the clerk's office yourself.
late_mail.es: Solo cuenta si el secretario de tu condado (county clerk) la recibe a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, sin importar el matasellos. Si queda poco tiempo, llévala tú a la oficina del secretario.
late_mail.quote: Ballots arriving after the deadline will not be counted.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on sos.wyo.gov (Elections FAQ, Absentee Voting, Voter ID, 2026 Key Election Dates PDF, 2026 Voter Guide PDF, the 2019 sticker contest PDF) and wyoleg.gov (Title 22 PDF: 22-26-113 electioneering, 22-3-118 proof of identity). EARLY VOTING for states.js: in-person absentee voting, Tuesday, October 6 to Monday, November 2, 2026. Key Dates quote: 'Absentee Voting: ... General Election …… October 6 – November 2, 2026'; FAQ: 'Absentee voting begins 28 days prior to the election (45 days for military or overseas voters) and ends the day before the election.' Source URL: https://sos.wyo.gov/Elections/Docs/2026/2026_Key_Election_Dates.pdf. CONFLICT on the regular registration deadline: the Key Dates PDF says 'Voter Registration Closes: General …… October 19, 2026', while the FAQ says 'The deadline for voter registration is 14 days before an election' and the Voter Guide says 'by mail not less than (14) days before an election', which counts to October 20 (14 days before November 3). The live faq_text.py WY 'reg' answer says October 20. Both dates have passed and same-day registration is open, so reg_deadline gives only the same-day route and no regular date. local_offices_url is the 2026 Voter Guide PDF, whose last two pages list all 23 county clerks; no HTML county clerk list was found. No ballot tracker: the SOS absentee page says to contact the county clerk. 'mail it early' in mail_return rests on the SOS line '(Mail delivery within the county may take up to seven (7) days, and longer if you’re mailing your ballot from outside the county.)'.

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., or until the last person in line at 7 p.m. has voted.
